import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler
sc=bpy.context.scene
def mat(n,c,r=0.5,m=0.0):
    M=bpy.data.materials.get(n) or bpy.data.materials.new(n)
    M.use_nodes=True; b=M.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=r; b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=m
    return M
asphalt=mat('Asphalt',(0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9); grass=mat('Grass',(0.1,0.35,0.08),1)
red=mat('CurbRed',(0.8,0.05,0.04),0.6); white=mat('White',(0.9,0.9,0.9),0.6)
body=mat('CarBody',(0.05,0.35,0.9),0.3,0.3); accent=mat('CarAccent',(1.0,0.55,0.0),0.4)
tire=mat('Tire',(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.8); glass=mat('Glass',(0.02,0.03,0.05),0.1); rim=mat('Rim',(0.6,0.6,0.62),0.3,1)

# centerline: rounded rectangle
A,B,R=60,35,18
pts=[]
def arc(cx,cy,a0,n=12):
    for i in range(n+1):
        a=math.radians(a0+90*i/n); pts.append(Vector((cx+R*math.cos(a),cy+R*math.sin(a),0)))
# start bottom straight going +X
pts.append(Vector((-(A-R),-B,0)))
arc(A-R,-(B-R),-90); arc(A-R,B-R,0); arc(-(A-R),B-R,90); arc(-(A-R),-(B-R),180)
pts=pts[:-1]  # last equals first
# densify
cl=[]
for i in range(len(pts)):
    p,q=pts[i],pts[(i+1)%len(pts)]
    n=max(1,int((q-p).length/2))
    for k in range(n): cl.append(p.lerp(q,k/n))
N=len(cl)
def tang(i): return (cl[(i+1)%N]-cl[i-1]).normalized()
def strip(name,off_in,off_out,z,matl,alt=None):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm=bmesh.new()
    vs=[]
    for i in range(N):
        t=tang(i); nrm=Vector((-t.y,t.x,0))
        vs.append((bm.verts.new(cl[i]+nrm*off_in+Vector((0,0,z))),bm.verts.new(cl[i]+nrm*off_out+Vector((0,0,z)))))
    for i in range(N):
        a,b=vs[i],vs[(i+1)%N]
        f=bm.faces.new((a[0],b[0],b[1],a[1]))
        if alt: f.material_index=i%2
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(matl)
    if alt: o.data.materials.append(alt)
    for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
    if (me.polygons[0].normal.z<0):
        for p in me.polygons: p.flip()
    return o
W=6
strip('Track',-W,W,0.0,asphalt)
strip('Curb_Inner',W,W+1.2,0.03,red,white)
strip('Curb_Outer',-W-1.2,-W,0.03,red,white)
strip('CenterLine',-0.12,0.12,0.01,white)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(0,0,-0.02)); g=bpy.context.object; g.name='Ground'; g.scale=(200,140,1); g.data.materials.append(grass)
# start/finish line
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(-20,-B,0.015)); sl=bpy.context.object; sl.name='StartLine'; sl.scale=(1.0,2*W,1); sl.data.materials.append(white)
print(N)

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
M=bpy.data.materials
car=bpy.data.objects.new('Car',None); sc.collection.objects.link(car); car.empty_display_size=1
def mesh_from(name,verts,faces,matl,parent=car):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.parent=parent; o.data.materials.append(matl)
    bm=bmesh.new(); bm.from_mesh(me); bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    return o
def loft(sections):
    # sections: list of (x, halfwidth_bottom, halfwidth_top, z0, z1)
    v=[];f=[]
    for x,wb,wt,z0,z1 in sections:
        v+= [(x,-wb,z0),(x,wb,z0),(x,wt,z1),(x,-wt,z1)]
    n=len(sections)
    for i in range(n-1):
        a=i*4;b=a+4
        for k in range(4):
            f.append((a+k,a+(k+1)%4,b+(k+1)%4,b+k))
    f.append((3,2,1,0)); f.append(((n-1)*4,(n-1)*4+1,(n-1)*4+2,(n-1)*4+3))
    return v,f
# body: wedge nose to tail (x forward)
v,f=loft([(-2.2,0.85,0.75,0.18,0.75),(-1.2,0.95,0.85,0.15,0.85),(0.3,0.95,0.8,0.15,0.75),(1.5,0.8,0.6,0.15,0.5),(2.3,0.55,0.35,0.15,0.3)])
mesh_from('Car_Body',v,f,M['CarBody'])
# cockpit canopy
v,f=loft([(-1.0,0.55,0.35,0.8,1.15),(-0.3,0.6,0.4,0.8,1.25),(0.5,0.55,0.25,0.75,1.0),(0.9,0.45,0.15,0.7,0.78)])
mesh_from('Car_Canopy',v,f,M['Glass'])
# side pods (accent)
for s in (-1,1):
    v,f=loft([(-1.4,0.12,0.12,0.2,0.6),(0.2,0.12,0.12,0.2,0.62),(0.9,0.08,0.08,0.2,0.4)])
    v=[(x,y+s*0.98,z) for x,y,z in v]
    mesh_from('Car_SidePod_'+('L' if s>0 else 'R'),v,f,M['CarAccent'])
# nose stripe
v,f=loft([(-2.0,0.18,0.18,0.74,0.77),(1.4,0.18,0.18,0.52,0.55),(2.25,0.18,0.18,0.29,0.32)])
v=[(x,y,z+0.01) for x,y,z in v]
mesh_from('Car_Stripe',v,f,M['CarAccent'])
# front splitter
v,f=loft([(1.9,1.0,1.0,0.1,0.16),(2.5,1.0,1.0,0.1,0.14)])
mesh_from('Car_Splitter',v,f,M['CarAccent'])
# rear wing + struts
v,f=loft([(-2.45,0.95,0.95,1.15,1.2),(-1.95,0.95,0.95,1.22,1.27)])
mesh_from('Car_Wing',v,f,M['CarAccent'])
for s in (-1,1):
    v,f=loft([(-2.2,0.05,0.05,0.7,1.2),(-2.05,0.05,0.05,0.7,1.22)])
    v=[(x,y+s*0.6,z) for x,y,z in v]
    mesh_from('Car_Strut_'+str(s),v,f,M['Tire'])
    v,f=loft([(-2.5,0.03,0.03,0.95,1.35),(-1.9,0.03,0.03,1.0,1.35)])
    v=[(x,y+s*0.98,z) for x,y,z in v]
    mesh_from('Car_Endplate_'+str(s),v,f,M['CarBody'])
# wheels
wheels=[]
for i,(x,y) in enumerate([(1.45,0.95),(1.45,-0.95),(-1.45,0.95),(-1.45,-0.95)]):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10,radius=0.38,depth=0.32,location=(x,y,0.38),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
    w=bpy.context.object; w.name=f'Car_Wheel_{i}'; w.data.materials.append(M['Tire'])
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=0.2,depth=0.34,location=(x,y,0.38),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
    h=bpy.context.object; h.name=f'Car_Hub_{i}'; h.data.materials.append(M['Rim'])
    h.parent=w; h.matrix_parent_inverse=w.matrix_world.inverted()
    w.parent=car; wheels.append(w)
# headlights
for s in (-1,1):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=(2.0,s*0.55,0.42)); hl=bpy.context.object; hl.scale=(0.3,0.25,0.06)
    hl.name='Car_Light_'+str(s); hl.data.materials.append(M['White']); hl.parent=car
print('ok')

Ltot=L1+Lc+L2
def at(s):
    if s<=L1: return Vector((-10+s,-B,0)),0.0
    s-=L1
    if s<=Lc:
        a=-math.pi/2+s/R
        return Vector((A-R+R*math.cos(a),-(B-R)+R*math.sin(a),0)),a+math.pi/2
    s-=Lc
    return Vector((A,-(B-R)+s,0)),math.pi/2

import numpy as np
frames=list(range(1,121))
